sloka: विदेहराजस्य सुता स्नुषा दशरथस्य च ।रामपत्नी कथं दु:खं सम्प्राप्ता निर्जने वने ॥ २.१०३.२४॥
transliteration: videharājasya sutā snuṣā daśarathasya ca ।rāmapatnī kathaṁ du:khaṁ samprāptā nirjane vane ॥ 2.103.24॥

translations.english: How is it that Sita, daughter of Janaka, king of Videha, daughterinlaw of Dasaratha and wife of Rama, has to undergo such hardships in the lonely forest.
